sources.summary: VENTUROUS exhibition charts a decade of innovative design research and practice from RMIT PhD alumni in Architecture & Urban Design. RMIT Galleries’ latest exhibition brings together the work of 23 practitioners, all alumni of RMIT’s School of Architecture & Urban Design’s pioneering design practice PhD program. VENTUROUS: Design Practice Research Futures in Architecture & Urban Design draws on the last decade of graduates from the RMIT School of Architecture & Urban Design’s design practice PhD program.
